dimensions.analysis: Before touching code, the candidate read the failing test and diff, and explicitly checked the spec against the observed behavior of a partially shipped hold returning only unshipped units. This matches the expected clarify behavior almost exactly.

The candidate stated a precise mechanism hypothesis - that the sweep releases the original count instead of the remaining count - before opening the source file, which is exactly the level of specificity the bar calls for.

The candidate narrated the diff interpretation, the spec question, the hypothesis, and the confirmation of the exact code line at fault, giving a clear play-by-play an interviewer could follow without interruption.
The edit made was directly the fix implied by the stated hypothesis (subtracting shipped units from released units) and was applied and saved in a single coherent pass with no thrashing.
The candidate re-ran the full test suite after the fix and confirmed it passed before ending the session, rather than declaring success purely from reading the diff.

The closing statement explicitly ties the fix back to the root cause - phantom stock from releasing the original count - and explains why subtracting shipped units resolves it, matching the ground truth mechanism precisely.
